COMPUTER STUDIES MARCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: COMPUTER STUDIES MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. Input Cable Tester
   D. International Cricket Team

2. When learning Artificial Intelligence Implications and Ethics, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Artificial Intelligence Implications and Ethics.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Artificial Intelligence Implications and Ethics.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Artificial Intelligence Implications and Ethics.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Artificial Intelligence Implications and Ethics.

3. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Data Structures and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Web Development II and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Software Development Life Cycle and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
